SECP.description: Composite Section for PSC Design (SECP). Per section key, defines whether the composite section is used for PSC design and the two-part (index 0 = pre-composite/part I, index 1 = post-composite/part J) geometry values Z1/Z2/Z3, t1/t2/t3 and total thickness.

bCompPSC.description: Use Composite Section for PSC Design flag (stored as a double; use 0 for off, 1 for on).

Z1_0.description: Z1 value for part index 0 (pre-composite section).

Z2_0.description: Z2 value for part index 0 (pre-composite section).

Z3_0.description: Z3 value for part index 0 (pre-composite section).

t1_0.description: t1 thickness value for part index 0 (pre-composite section).

t2_0.description: t2 thickness value for part index 0 (pre-composite section).

t3_0.description: t3 thickness value for part index 0 (pre-composite section).

TotT_0.description: Total thickness (TorT) for part index 0 (pre-composite section).

Z1_1.description: Z1 value for part index 1 (post-composite section).

Z2_1.description: Z2 value for part index 1 (post-composite section).

Z3_1.description: Z3 value for part index 1 (post-composite section).

t1_1.description: t1 thickness value for part index 1 (post-composite section).

t2_1.description: t2 thickness value for part index 1 (post-composite section).

t3_1.description: t3 thickness value for part index 1 (post-composite section).

TotT_1.description: Total thickness (TorT) for part index 1 (post-composite section).
